Security Policy Directive #1: POLICY DIRECTIVE: All employees must change workstation passwords every 90 days. Passwords must contain at least 14 characters, including uppercase letters, numbers, and symbols. Ref: ISO-27001-Sec-1.

Security Policy Directive #2: COMPLIANCE MANDATE: Data exfiltration prevention protocol requires all external email attachments exceeding 10MB to undergo automated DLP inspection prior to release. Ref: ISO-27001-Sec-2.

Security Policy Directive #3: ACCESS CONTROL DIRECTIVE: System administrators must enforce multi-factor authentication on all remote access sessions. Shared credentials are strictly prohibited under Section 4.2. Ref: ISO-27001-Sec-3.

Security Policy Directive #4: INCIDENT RESPONSE PROTOCOL: In the event of suspected unauthorized account access, security officers are mandated to immediately isolate the affected workstation and revoke access tokens. Ref: ISO-27001-Sec-4.

Security Policy Directive #5: DATA RETENTION POLICY: Customer transaction records must be archived for seven years in immutable storage. Premature deletion is prohibited under financial compliance rules. Ref: ISO-27001-Sec-5.
